text: {"assertions":["A blank render issue in ui/components/DataTable.tsx was fixed on 2026-02-03.","The issue manifested as an empty tbody element with no console errors.","The root cause was two database writes that were not wrapped in a transaction.","The fix involved wrapping both writes in a single transaction, submitted as PR #1765 on branch fix/blank-render-1.","The issue could be reproduced by opening the data table with a saved column layout.","The fix recovered 82 GB of blob storage.","The component is written in TypeScript and tested in ui/components/DataTable.test.tsx."]}
